description: Validated TinyRDT recipe that passes the 10-demo offline overfit gate (docs/reports/01_closed_loop_diagnostics.md). Pass as CLI flags to training/audit_overfit.py.
train_subset: first 10 episodes of the seed-17 training split (CLEAN10 = [0,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9,11])
cli: python -m training.audit_overfit --output artifacts/research_audit/cosine_x0_hold_ema --schedule cosine --prediction x0 --padding hold --steps 20000 --seed 17 --batch-size 8 --learning-rate 0.001 --device cuda --eval-interval 2000 --ema-decay 0.999
